text: The competitor’s new customer loyalty program, which integrates discounts, rewards, and personalized experiences via their mobile app, poses a significant strategic threat. By enhancing customer retention through seamless digital engagement, they are likely to increase customer lifetime value and reduce churn. This directly impacts our business by potentially shrinking our customer base as users migrate to the competitor’s more rewarding ecosystem. To mitigate this, we must accelerate our own digital loyalty initiatives, focus on unique value propositions beyond price incentives, and strengthen direct customer relationships to prevent further erosion of market share.
